source: Pedretti & AOTA Guidelines - Splinting & Orthotics Compendium
content:
Master OT Splinting Compendium:
1. Radial Nerve Injury: Dynamic Extensor Splint (maintains wrist in 30 deg extension with dynamic outrigger providing passive finger/thumb extension and active flexion) OR Static Wrist Cock-up in 20-30 deg extension.
2. Low Median Nerve Palsy / Carpal Tunnel: Short Opponens / C-bar splint (thumb palmar abduction & slight opposition for pinch grip); Neutral wrist cock-up (0-15 deg extension) for CTS.
3. Ulnar Nerve Palsy: Knuckle Bender / Lumbrical bar splint (prevents 4th & 5th MCP hyperextension, keeps MCP at 30-45 deg flexion, directing extensor tendon force to extend IP joints).
4. High Median + Ulnar Palsy: Combination lumbrical bar and opponens splint.
5. Rheumatoid Arthritis: Resting Hand Splint / Pan splint (worn at night during acute flare; wrist 10-20 deg extension, MCP 20-30 deg flexion, IP slight flexion, thumb slight abduction) to prevent ulnar drift; Day splints: Ring splints for swan neck / boutonniere, wrist support.
6. Burns (Hand): Intrinsic Plus / Safe Position Splint (Wrist 20-30 deg extension, MCP 70-90 deg flexion, IPs fully extended 0 deg, thumb in maximum palmar abduction).
7. Spastic Hemiplegia: Spasticity reduction splint (Bobath finger spreader, antispastic resting splint in neutral position to inhibit flexor hypertonicity).
8. C6 Spinal Cord Injury: Tenodesis splint / Wrist-driven flexor hinge splint (translates active wrist extension into passive 3-jaw chuck pinch).

Master OT Assessment Tools Compendium:
1. Functional Independence Measure (FIM): 18 items (13 motor, 5 cognitive), scored 1 (Total Assistance) to 7 (Complete Independence). Total score 18-126.
2. Modified Barthel Index (MBI): 10 ADL items scored 0-100 measuring functional level in feeding, bathing, grooming, dressing, bowel/bladder, toilet, transfers, mobility, stairs.
3. Fugl-Meyer Assessment (FMA): Gold-standard quantitative evaluative measure of post-stroke motor recovery based on Brunnstrom stages (UE motor score max 66, LE motor score max 34).
4. Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS): Grades muscle spasticity from 0 (No increase in tone) to 4 (Rigid in flexion or extension) with 1+ indicating slight increase manifested by catch and release with minimal resistance.
5. Canadian Occupational Performance Measure (COPM): Client-centred outcome measure identifying self-care, productivity, and leisure priorities, rated on 1-10 scales for Performance and Satisfaction.
6. Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand (DASH): 30-item self-report questionnaire assessing upper extremity symptoms and disability.
7. Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA): 30-point screening tool for mild cognitive impairment; score below 26 indicates impairment.
